stressed.score_definition: final: mean worst min(3,eligible_years) yearly rates, recent 2020-2023 gate. dev_score_raw: 0.7 * (mean worst 2 of 4 contiguous fold pass rates * positive-year fraction) + 0.3 * econ_grade; caller subtracts knob penalty

base.score_definition: final: mean worst min(3,eligible_years) yearly rates, recent 2020-2023 gate. dev_score_raw: 0.7 * (mean worst 2 of 4 contiguous fold pass rates * positive-year fraction) + 0.3 * econ_grade; caller subtracts knob penalty

limitations: OHLC aggregate extremes assume simultaneous adverse moves
reference ledger, rolling MLL attempts stop separately
fees and exposure weights are estimates; no live broker guarantee
no null pass inferred unless human protocol assesses diagnostics
